generator_quality.note: Train-only trajectory-envelope calibration. It mirrors IMFL-AIGC's empirical max-over-short-FL-training strategy more closely than the initial-model proxy; it is still an empirical envelope, not a formal supremum over all w.

audit.meaning: train-only diagnostic; not a uniform gradient residual certificate

augmentation_semantics: addition_only: retain every original sample and add class-targeted AIGC samples
training_semantics: fixed original-data local compute; sample from the real+synthetic mixture with replacement
aggregation_semantics: FedAvg weights use original client sample counts
interpretation: Generator-aware empirical experiment. Trajectory quality is a train-only empirical envelope; actual CNN accuracy remains an empirical outcome.
